title: WaterColor 79 Dandelion
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 14 wristbands.- 6 adult bikes- Rooftop deck with views of Western Lake - Wireless Internet- This property comes with 3 dedicated parking spots. Additional parking can be found throughout the community.- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout.DETAILS: WaterColor 79 Dandelion is a sparkling 6-bedroom, 5.5-bathroom Main House—plus a Carriage House—that sleeps 14. Tucked away in the "Cottage District" overlooking the lake, enjoy terrific community amenities, including access to the private beach club and multiple pools. With nearly 3,700 square feet of living space, guests will love the accessible wheelchair ramp, ping pong table, wonderful second-floor balconies, and the rooftop deck!The main floor of the Main House exudes a cozy and inviting ambiance that sets the tone for a peaceful lakeside retreat. Upon entering, guests are greeted by an open living space adorned with warm interiors and breathtaking views of the tranquil lake. The living area is well-lit and vibrantly decorated, with an additional sitting area in front of large picture windows. The traditional dining area seats 8, with room for 3 more at the breakfast bar. A gourmet kitchen equipped with top-of-the-line appliances and spacious countertops is a chef's dream. Step onto the screened porch right off the kitchen and find an alfresco dining table with endless views of the waters below. Passed the wet bar is a primary bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom.The second floor is a haven for guests seeking comfort and relaxation. A cozy twin-over-twin bunk nook with built-in cabinets is great for kids. An upstairs living room shares screened-in balcony access—boasting a ping pong table—with one of the guest bedrooms featuring a queen bed and private bathroom. Another balcony on this level is connected by 2 other guest bedrooms—1 with 2 twin beds and great views, the other with a queen bed. The true highlight of this floor is the remarkable rooftop deck, with breathtaking views of Western Lake. Take advantage of the outdoor kitchen and comfortable seating for a blissful alfresco dining experience.An open area on the ground floor separates the Main House from the Carriage House, which features all the comforts of home with a kitchenette, living area, sleeper sofa, full Murphy bed, and private bathroom.WaterColor 79 Dandelion comes with 3 dedicated parking spots—plus 6 complimentary adult bikes—perfect for exploring nearby beach access at Van Ness Butler and Santa Clara. Book this enchanting property today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 14):FIRST FLOOR:Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and TubAdditional sleeping area: Sleeper sofaSECOND FLOOR:Bunk Room: Twin over Twin Bunk Bed, Shared Hallway Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboGuest Bedroom: Two Twin Beds, Shared Hallway Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboGuest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Hallway Bathroom with Shower OnlyGuest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyCARRIAGE HOUSE:Full Murphy Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyWeddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.Please note: Effective March 15, 2014, Low-Speed Vehicle rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 80 vehicles throughout the community at any given time. Only one cart may be rented per home and rentals will be granted on a first-come, first-served basis.

This home is allotted 14 wristbands. - 6 adult bikes - Rooftop deck with views of Western Lake - Wireless Internet - This property comes with 3 dedicated parking spots. Additional parking can be found throughout the community. - Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout. DETAILS: WaterColor 79 Dandelion is a sparkling 6-bedroom, 5.5-bathroom Main House—plus a Carriage House—that sleeps 14. Tucked away in the "Cottage District" overlooking the lake, enjoy terrific community amenities, including access to the private beach club and multiple pools. With nearly 3,700 square feet of living space, guests will love the accessible wheelchair ramp, ping pong table, wonderful second-floor balconies, and the rooftop deck! The main floor of the Main House exudes a cozy and inviting ambiance that sets the tone for a peaceful lakeside retreat. Upon entering, guests are greeted by an open living space adorned with warm interiors and breathtaking views of the tranquil lake. The living area is well-lit and vibrantly decorated, with an additional sitting area in front of large picture windows. The traditional dining area seats 8, with room for 3 more at the breakfast bar. A gourmet kitchen equipped with top-of-the-line appliances and spacious countertops is a chef's dream. Step onto the screened porch right off the kitchen and find an alfresco dining table with endless views of the waters below. Passed the wet bar is a primary bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom. The second floor is a haven for guests seeking comfort and relaxation. A cozy twin-over-twin bunk nook with built-in cabinets is great for kids. An upstairs living room shares screened-in balcony access—boasting a ping pong table—with one of the guest bedrooms featuring a queen bed and private bathroom. Another balcony on this level is connected by 2 other guest bedrooms—1 with 2 twin beds and great views, the other with a queen bed. The true highlight of this floor is the remarkable rooftop deck, with breathtaking views of Western Lake. Take advantage of the outdoor kitchen and comfortable seating for a blissful alfresco dining experience. An open area on the ground floor separates the Main House from the Carriage House, which features all the comforts of home with a kitchenette, living area, sleeper sofa, full Murphy bed, and private bathroom. WaterColor 79 Dandelion comes with 3 dedicated parking spots—plus 6 complimentary adult bikes—perfect for exploring nearby beach access at Van Ness Butler and Santa Clara. Book this enchanting property today!
